usage: Save as extract_fields.py after review. Run with Python 3: python extract_fields.py < input.json. Alternatively, import extract_fields and call it with the input object. Returns {"fields": {...}} or {"error": "invalid_input"}. Labels match exactly before the first colon; values have surrounding whitespace removed and retain embedded colons and Unicode. Absent fields are omitted; repeated requested labels are rejected. Unrequested labels and lines without a colon (including bare 'id') are ignored. These whitespace and malformed-line conventions are assumptions because the supplied inputs contain no expected outputs. Uses only the standard library; source has not been executed.
